node.statement: At every matrix level, composition distributes to give Phi Delta-Delta=(Phi-Delta Upsilon)Delta+Delta(Upsilon Delta-I_B). Taking cb norms, using the triangle inequality and submultiplicativity, then node 1.2.1.1 and the two root hypotheses, yields ||Phi Delta-Delta||_cb <= ||Phi-Delta Upsilon||_cb ||Delta||_cb + ||Delta||_cb ||Upsilon Delta-I_B||_cb <= epsilon+epsilon=2*epsilon. Thus the constant 2 no longer relies on pending node 1.1.
